summary_en: Cancellation of all treasury shares held at reference date 2026-08-17 (immediately before UserBase acquires all ordinary shares). Also to acquire all restricted-transfer shares without compensation during restriction period and include them in cancellation. Specific share count and percentage of shares outstanding contingent on UserBase acquisition completion.
title_en: Notice Regarding Free Acquisition of Restricted-Transfer Shares and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-13, Global Information's board resolved to cancel all treasury shares held at the reference date of 2026-08-17 (immediately before UserBase acquires all ordinary shares of the company). The cancellation is conditional upon completion of UserBase's share purchase request as approved by the board. The company also resolved to acquire, without compensation, all restricted-transfer shares during their restriction period under the terms of the restricted-transfer share allocation agreement, and to include those shares in the cancellation after their acquisition. As of 2026-07-13, the company holds 699 treasury shares out of 2,976,100 total issued shares. The exact number of shares to be cancelled and the percentage of shares outstanding will be determined at the reference date when the acquisition takes effect.
